vulnerability.explanation: finddiff2(rp, b1, bits, PIXEL(rp, b1)) evaluates PIXEL(rp, b1) unconditionally due to the macro definition, even when b1 == bits. This causes PIXEL to read rp[b1 >> 3], which is one byte past the end of the row buffer when bits is a multiple of 8. b1 can legitimately equal bits (e.g., a reference line of uniform color makes finddiff return bits), leading to an OOB read.
